blocks.text: You can view the Sandbox Verdict Insights Logs data, depending on the filters you applied, in a table format. To learn more about logs, see About Insights Logs.
You can view the following Sandbox Verdict Logs column fields:

blocks.item: Analysis Completed Time: Displays the timestamp of when the Sandbox analysis of the payload is completed.
Download File Type: Displays the downloaded file type.
File MD5: Displays the MD5 hash of suspicious files. Click the MD5 hash value to view the Sandbox Detail Report.
File SHA256: Displays the SHA-256 hash of suspicious files.
Tactic: Displays the MITRE ATT&CK techniques and tactics IDs.
Threat Name: Displays the name of the threat detected. Click the threat name to learn more about the threat in the Zscaler Threat Library.
Verdict: Displays the verdict of the Sandbox analysis. Verdicts include Benign, Suspicious, or Sandbox subtypes (e.g., Ransomware, Sandbox Offensive Security Tools).
